caption:
Your journal is more useful when it records the decision—not just the profit.

Record the setup, the reason for entry, the invalidation point, the risk, and whether you followed your rules. Review a group of trades to look for repeated process errors. A small sample can be misleading, and a journal cannot remove uncertainty, but it can make your learning more structured.

Educational content only; not financial advice.
